# Roboto-Regular.ttf — third-party test fixture

**Copyright 2011 Google Inc. All Rights Reserved.**

Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (see `LICENSE-Roboto.txt`
in this directory, the unmodified upstream licence text).

This is Story 1.5's one small Latin test face (AC26: "1.5 builds the
`FontSet` type, the resolution seam and the subsetting path, and tests
against one small Latin test face"). It is used ONLY to exercise the
font-embedding and subsetting mechanism in this repository's tests and
fixtures. It is not a shipped production face — Noto Sans / Noto Sans
Thai / Noto Sans SC are Story 2.2's production faces (AC26 scope fence).

Sourced from `github.com/boxesandglue/textshape@v0.0.15`'s own test
fixtures (`testdata/fonts/Roboto-Regular.ttf`), which redistribute the
same upstream Google Roboto release under Apache-2.0.

AD-26, verbatim: "Redistributed non-code assets keep their own terms and
their notices." This is the repository's first non-code redistributed
asset (D-1.5.6) — it sets the pattern `lint/MANIFEST.md`'s redistributed
non-code assets table (see AC25) follows for Story 2.2.
